children: Adam Boehler, through entities he controls, acquired a 5.07% stake in Privia Health Group, Inc. common stock. The Schedule 13D was filed on Sep. 08, 2026 following recent open-market trades in July through September. The move positions Boehler to engage with Privia Health’s leadership and other stakeholders.

Boehler’s group bought the shares for investment and plans to regularly "review their investments" in Privia Health. They expect to "communicate with officers and directors" and may also speak with other shareholders, analysts, and potential partners as they evaluate the company; they could buy more shares or sell some based on that ongoing review.

Adam Boehler is an American investor and the founder of Rubicon Founders, an investment firm focused on healthcare services. He previously led the U.S. International Development Finance Corporation and served as the founding director of the Center for Medicare and Medicaid Innovation. The filing group includes Delaware entities tied to Rubicon Founders that manage and hold the Privia Health stake.
